name: No torn reads
mechanism: Payload written before the swap (AcqRel orders it); reader reaches a buffer only via a swap that transferred exclusive ownership

name: Wait-free writer
mechanism: Single `exchange` — no spin, no retry, no CAS loop

name: Wait-free reader
mechanism: Single `exchange` — no spin, no retry, cannot fail

name: Latest-wins
mechanism: `latest` names the freshest publish; claims take `latest`

name: No back-pressure
mechanism: Writer needs only its private `w_work`, refreshed by its own swap

name: No use-after-free across FFI
mechanism: `revoked` set (Release) before free; writer checks per publish (one Relaxed load); free deferred until writer quiescence
